svg.aria-label: FLITO: Freight matching platform for Nepal. Gives Nepal's trucks paying loads on the trip home. Shippers post a load for up to 10 trucks, verified owners quote per truck, and drivers run each trip from a one-button job screen, in Nepali and English.

g.text: Gives Nepal's trucks paying loads on the trip home.
Shippers post a load for up to 10 trucks, verified
owners quote per truck, and drivers run each trip
from a one-button job screen, in Nepali and English.
Ranked truck matching; conditional updates stop
Live trip map on Leaflet, OpenStreetMap and
OSRM, with arrival times for a loaded truck
Payments recorded without holding money, PDF
invoices, fees billed by Nepali month
